source: Back-office: look up a paged table (DataTables example table, 57 fixed rows)
start: A clean desktop

goal.zh: 用 Edge 開 https://datatables.net/examples/core/basic_init/zero_configuration.html ，把這張表當成我們的員工名冊。倫敦（London）辦公室的員工有幾位、年薪加總是多少、誰的到職日最早、是哪一天？照「人數；年薪總額；姓名，到職日」的格式回覆。
goal.en: Open https://datatables.net/examples/core/basic_init/zero_configuration.html in Edge and treat this table as our staff list. How many employees are in the London office, what is their total salary, and who started first, on what date? Reply in the format "count; total salary; name, start date".

expect: Replies 12; $3,339,260; Timothy Mooney, 2008-12-11 (the London staff span two pages: page through or show more rows per page)

source: Back-office: form validation and Traditional Chinese input (the httpbin form echoes what was sent)
start: A clean desktop

goal.zh: 用 Edge 開 https://httpbin.org/forms/post ，照下面的資料送出訂單：Customer name「Wang Hsiao-Ming」、Telephone「02-2345-6789」、E-mail「wang.hm@example.com」、Size 選 Large、Toppings 只勾 Bacon 和 Mushroom、Preferred delivery time 10:40、Delivery instructions「請按門鈴兩次」。如果表單不接受某個值，只把那個值改成表單能接受的最接近的值再送出。結果頁留著，告訴我你改了哪個值、為什麼。
goal.en: Open https://httpbin.org/forms/post in Edge and submit an order with these details: Customer name "Wang Hsiao-Ming", Telephone "02-2345-6789", E-mail "wang.hm@example.com", Size Large, Toppings only Bacon and Mushroom, Preferred delivery time 10:40, Delivery instructions "請按門鈴兩次". If the form does not accept a value, change only that value to the closest one it accepts, then submit. Leave the result page open and tell me which value you changed and why.

expect: The result page's form has custname, custtel and custemail as given, size large, topping only bacon and mushroom, delivery 11:00, and comments "請按門鈴兩次" (shown on the page as \u8acb\u6309\u9580\u9234\u5169\u6b21); the reply says 10:40 was changed to 11:00 because 11:00 is the earliest allowed
